s-1.ptxt: Inspect Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

s2.ptxt: Remove the radiator cap.

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the radiator cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

s2.ptxt: Inspect for excessive rust or scale deposits around the radiator cap and water inlet.

atten4.ptxt: If excessively dirty, replace the coolant.

s2.ptxt: Install the radiator cap.
Inspect the oil for deterioration, water entry, discoloration or thinning, and replace the oil if the quality is visibly poor.
Inspect the battery specific gravity of each cell.

atten4.ptxt: If it is not within the standard, charge the battery.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Air Cleaner Filter Element Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Inspect the air cleaner filter element for dirt and clogging.
Inspect the entire circumference of the belt for rib condition, wear and cracks.

item.ptxt: Replace the belt if it is worn to the point where the core wire is visible.
Replace the belt if cracks reach the core wire (1 or more locations).
Replace the belt if rib rubber is chipped (1 or more locations).
Replace the belt every 100,000 km even if there is no damage.
Because an automatic tensioner is used, measuring the tension and deflection is not necessary.

s2.ptxt: Check that the belt is correctly installed on each pulley.
Stop the engine from idle speed and check that the belt does not protrude beyond the width of the tensioner pulley.
Remove the belt from the tensioner pulley, move the tensioner in the right and left rotation directions, and check that it does not catch.
If there is a malfunction, replace the tensioner.
Install the V-ribbed belt.
Race the engine several times and check that there is no tapping noise from the engine.
If abnormal noise is heard, idle the engine in a warmed-up state for 30 minutes or more, and then inspect again.

atten4.ptxt: If a malfunction is found in the above inspection, inspect the lash adjusters. (see )

s2.ptxt: Inspection Using SST (TaSCAN)

s3.ptxt: Following the screen instructions, display the "ECU Data Monitor" - "Ignition Timing #1" screen and measure the ignition timing.

atten3.ptxt: Perform with A/C OFF, electric fan OFF, and in the N or P range.

s3.ptxt: Display the "Active Test" screen, select "Ignition Timing #1", and measure the ignition timing with "TC Terminal ON".
Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.

s2.ptxt: Inspection using general instruments

s3.ptxt: Using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect between terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

item.ptxt: Never short the wrong terminals, as this will cause a malfunction.
Perform with A/C OFF, electric fan OFF, and in the N or P range.

s3.ptxt: Remove the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )
Connect the clip of the timing light to the wire harness for the coil connector of cylinder No.1.

atten3.ptxt: Use a timing light that can detect the primary signal.

s3.ptxt: Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Check that the ignition timing is within the standard.
Check that the ignition timing advances quickly when the engine speed is increased.
Install the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )

s2.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Following the screen instructions, display the "ECU Data Monitor" screen and measure the engine speed.

atten3.ptxt: Perform with A/C OFF, electric fan OFF, and in the N or P range.

s2.ptxt: Remove the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )
Remove the V-bank cover.
Remove the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.
Remove the intake air surge tank assembly. (see )
Disconnect the 6 ignition coil assembly connectors.
Remove the 6 ignition coils.
Remove the 6 spark plugs.
Set the compression gauge.
Depress the brake pedal, push the engine switch and measure the compression of each cylinder.

item.ptxt: Perform the compression inspection in a short time.
After all work is completed, be sure to clear the stored DTCs, and then check that the normal code is output.

s2.ptxt: Install the 6 spark plugs.
Install the 6 ignition coils.
Connect the 6 ignition coil assembly connectors.
Install the intake air surge tank assembly. (see )
Install the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.
Install the V-bank cover.
Install the cowl top outside front w/ front wiper motor & link. (see )
After maintaining the engine speed at 2500r/min for 2 minutes, inspect the CO and HC concentration at idle.
